_comment: The Journey is the directed path a new character follows; contracts are the optional work alongside it. Both are built from the same objective kinds -- gather, craft, use, build, stake, kill, extract, visit, learn, sell -- so adding either is a data change. `target` means an item id, a POI name, or a skill id depending on kind. POI names are the wiki's own, which is why the path only works on the real region.

journey.name: First Thirst
journey.text: Water is the clock. Drink before you do anything else.

journey.name: Something To Work With
journey.text: Cut four plant fibre out of the agave.

journey.name: At The Bench
journey.text: Weave the fibre at your survival fabricator.

journey.name: A Suit Of Your Own
journey.text: Make a stillsuit. Every hour after this one costs you less water.

journey.name: Someone Who Knows
journey.text: Find a trainer and commit to a specialization.

journey.name: Water Without Walking
journey.text: Deploy a windtrap. Let the air pay you while you sleep.

journey.name: A Holding
journey.text: Stake a sub-fief. Nobody builds inside it but you.

journey.name: Know Your Ground
journey.text: Find Wali Hole. On open sand a cave is the only argument you have.

journey.name: The Basin Is Occupied
journey.text: Clear three of whatever is holding the camps.

journey.name: Water Is Water
journey.text: Draw a body. You will stop minding after the first one.

journey.name: Testing Station 2
journey.text: Take a blade out to the Emperor's Wings and prove it works.

journey.name: Griffin's Reach
journey.text: Walk in to the trading post and sell what you do not need.

contracts.name: Standing Order: Water
contracts.text: The post buys water at a premium this week. Bring six.

contracts.name: Standing Order: Cisterns
contracts.text: Anyone can carry water. Build something that keeps it.

contracts.name: Ore For The Post
contracts.text: Eight iron out of the rock, and we will not ask which rock.

contracts.name: Refined Goods
contracts.text: Ore is ore. Bring it back as steel.

contracts.name: Thinning The Camps
contracts.text: Five of them. Do not be precious about how.

contracts.name: Nothing Wasted
contracts.text: Three bodies drawn. On Arrakis that is not cruelty, it is book-keeping.

contracts.name: Survey: The Safeways
contracts.text: Four caves on the map, and I want to know they are still there.

contracts.name: Survey: The Wrecks
contracts.text: Three wrecks. Take what you like, tell me what is there.
